title: Millions in India Take Part in World Yoga Day

image.attribution: Joe Laurence, Seychelles News Agency / Wikimedia Commons / CC-BY-4.0

main_content:
Sprawled out in parks on colorful mats, millions of people across Indian towns and cities bent, stretched, and did breathing exercises on the second International Yoga Day.

Before joining a group of about 30,000 in the north Indian city of Chandigarh for a mass session in which he performed yoga exercises effortlessly, Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi pitched yoga as a secular practice that promotes health.

questions.question: What did people in India do on the second International Yoga Day?
options: They engaged in group meditation sessions.
They attended yoga workshops with international instructors.
They participated in mass yoga exercises in parks.
They watched yoga performances on television.
questions.answer: They participated in mass yoga exercises in parks.

questions.question: What did Narendra Modi say about yoga?
options: It is a practice primarily for spiritual enlightenment.
It is essential for achieving a balanced diet.
It is a secular practice that promotes health.
It should only be practiced indoors for better focus.
questions.answer: It is a secular practice that promotes health.
